local state
for i=1,60 do
 state=workspace:GetAttribute('FieldErr')
 if state=='PASS:algiers_kasbah' or (type(state)=='string' and string.sub(state,1,5)=='FAIL:') then break end
 task.wait(0.3)
end
assert(state=='PASS:algiers_kasbah','REGION_BUILD_OR_CRASH:algiers_kasbah:'..tostring(state))
local pl=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
local scene=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene'),'REGION_SCENE_MISSING:algiers_kasbah')
assert(scene:GetAttribute('FieldRegion')=='ottoman','REGION_WRONG_BACKGROUND:algiers_kasbah:'..tostring(scene:GetAttribute('FieldRegion')))
local ground=assert(scene:FindFirstChild('FieldGround'),'REGION_GROUND_MISSING:algiers_kasbah')
assert(ground.Size.X>=180,'REGION_GROUND_INVALID:algiers_kasbah')
assert(scene:FindFirstChild('FieldSafetyFloor'),'REGION_FALL_SAFETY_MISSING:algiers_kasbah')
local hud=assert(pl.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('FieldGui'),'REGION_HUD_MISSING:algiers_kasbah')
assert(hud.Enabled,'REGION_HUD_DISABLED:algiers_kasbah')
assert(workspace:GetAttribute('FieldCombatReady')==true,'REGION_COMBAT_NOT_READY:algiers_kasbah')
local root=assert(pl.Character and pl.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'),'REGION_RIG_MISSING:algiers_kasbah')
assert(root.Position.X>2500 and not root.Anchored,'REGION_PLAYER_TRAPPED:algiers_kasbah')
assert(pl.Character:GetAttribute('EquippedWeaponId')=='sword','REGION_WEAPON_MISSING:algiers_kasbah')
local mobs,rigged=0,0
for _,m in scene:GetChildren() do
 if m:IsA('Model') and m.Name=='FieldEnemy' then
  mobs+=1
  if m:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') and type(m:GetAttribute('MotionRole'))=='string' then rigged+=1 end
 end
end
assert(mobs>0 and mobs==rigged,'REGION_MOBS_OR_MOTION_FAILED:algiers_kasbah:'..mobs..'/'..rigged)
local size=ground.Size.X
local origin=Vector3.new(3000,0,0)
workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',70)
workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(origin+Vector3.new(0,38,size/2+22),origin+Vector3.new(0,2,size/2-60)))
return 'REGION_QA_PASS:ottoman:algiers_kasbah:mobs='..mobs..':motions='..rigged
